overall_assessment: The provider policy compliance, public API policy, and SemVer governance codified across integration/provider-contract-baselines.json, release/public-packages.json, scripts/check_public_package_policy.py, scripts/check_provider_contract_baselines.py, and tests/test_shared_provider_runtime_governance.py uphold strict ecosystem standards. In release/public-packages.json, all crates remain non-publishable (publish: false) until formal release train evidence is recorded, preventing accidental premature registry publications. Provider baseline contracts in integration/provider-contract-baselines.json declare rate intervals, allowed endpoints, and required authentication scopes fail-closed. Governance tests in tests/test_shared_provider_runtime_governance.py pass 100% network-free.
verified_invariants: Non-publishable default: release/public-packages.json enforces publish = false across all workspace crates
Provider policy baselines: integration/provider-contract-baselines.json enforces rate limits, retry backoffs, and allowed hosts
Public API governance: check_public_package_policy.py and test_local_api_evidence.py validate API surfaces and prevent drift
Deterministic verification: all static checks and unit tests pass network-free

findings.description: Provider contract baselines and package policies are verified; running live semver checks against published crates remains an operational release-stage gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate for live cargo-semver-checks execution during release train promotion.

assertions_evaluated.notes: SemVer and public API policy implications verified with non-publishable crate controls.

limitations: Package policy and baseline provider contracts verified; live semver checks on released crates remain release-stage actions.
